review.en: Kim Jung Mi's album was written and produced by Shin Jung-hyeon, the guitarist and songwriter at the centre of Korean rock in the early seventies. Her soft, airy singing over his long, slow-burning psychedelic arrangements gave Korean pop something it had not had. Largely forgotten for decades, it returned through reissues in the 2000s and became one of the best-known Korean records abroad.
review.zh: 金贞美的这张专辑由申重铉作曲并制作，他是七十年代初韩国摇滚的核心人物。她轻柔空灵的歌声，配上他悠长、慢慢燃起的迷幻编曲，给韩国流行乐带来了此前没有的东西。这张唱片被遗忘了几十年，2000 年代再版后重新流传，成了海外最为人知的韩国唱片之一。
